# CsStrats

> The working surface for competitive Counter-Strike 2 teams: a tactics library, a .dem demo viewer with 2D and 3D playback, and a collaborative Strat Builder. Built in Odense, Denmark by IS Digital ApS.

CsStrats is a web application used by competitive CS2 teams to prepare for matches and learn from them. Three tools share one room: the **Tactics library** (curated Tier 1 and Tier 2 pro plays by map, updated weekly), the **Demoviewer** (drop a .dem file or a FACEIT URL, get a parsed match with round-by-round playback, kill events, plants, defuses, and utility pops in 2D or 3D), and the **Strat Builder** (a collaborative 2D map tool with per-player timed paths, run and walk speeds, scheduled utility throws for smoke, flash, HE, and molotov, and timeline playback).

The primary audience is IGLs, coaches, and managers running competitive CS2 teams globally, from amateur and semi-pro tiers to academy rosters. Serious individual players also use it to analyse their own demos before promotion games.

## Product

- [Tactics library](https://csstrats.dk/#tactics): Curated Tier 1 / Tier 2 tactics by map, weekly updates, filter by side, type, map, team, and tags.
- [Demoviewer](https://csstrats.dk/#demoviewer): Parsed CS2 demos with 2D and 3D playback, per-round annotations, custom callouts attached to map geometry.
- [Strat Builder](https://csstrats.dk/#builder): Collaborative 2D map tool. Five player slots with named roles (IGL, Entry, AWP, Support, Lurk), timed waypoint paths, utility throws (smoke, flash, HE, molotov), timeline scrubbing.
- [How it works](https://csstrats.dk/#workflow): Three steps (upload, annotate, ship) for moving a demo into a runnable team strat.

## Pricing

All paid plans cover one team of up to 8 players, unlimited tactics, unlimited demos. VAT added where applicable. Cancel any time from the user profile.

- **Team Monthly** &mdash; €24.95 per month, month-to-month.
- **Team Every 6 Months** &mdash; €19.95 per month, billed €119.95 every six months.
- **Team Annual** &mdash; €15.83 per month, billed €190 once a year. Best value; save 36.6% versus monthly.

CsStrats is a paid product. There is no free plan and no trial. Pick a plan to get full access. Tournament promo codes apply at checkout, then auto-renew at the regular rate every billing cycle until cancelled.

## FAQ

- **What is CsStrats?** A web app for competitive CS2 teams: tactics library, demo viewer, Strat Builder, stratbooks.
- **Which games?** Counter-Strike 2 only. The parser accepts .dem files from CS2 matchmaking, FACEIT, ESEA, and tournament servers.
- **Is there a free plan or trial?** No. CsStrats is a paid product for competitive teams. There is no free plan or trial; pick a plan for full access.
- **Who builds it?** IS Digital ApS, based in Odense, Denmark.

## Brand

Brand line: "The room where the strats live."
Brand personality: composed, exacting, competitive. Voice of a coach who has watched a lot of demos and is not impressed easily.
